The scholar [[Hethan Romund]] was '''rescued''' from the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Malefax]] by several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] allies.

==Prelude==
The [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Hethan Romund]] spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] searching [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for information about the fallen [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and in the process met or trained a number of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals&mdash;[[Pon Edestus]], [[Belandi Feearr]], [[Dao Jodh]], [[Kaveri Ra]], [[Tarast Voon]], and [[Sarenda]]. When she was captured by the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Malefax]], at the last moment she transferred a message to those individuals.

==The mission==
First, they had to scale a valley to reach the [[Dawn Temple]] on [[Mount Tellec/Legends|Mount Tellec]].

They then encountered the [[Gatekeeper (Mount Tellec)|Gatekeeper]] who questioned the individuals about their purpose their. They eventually moved on.

Afterward, they encountered a group of [[hunter]]s who had been corrupted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

They became captured in pits, but were able to escape using their [[The Force/Legends|Force powers]].

The Force-sensitives then had to traverse a bridge to the temple which was guarded by [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]].

On their way to the temple, they were ambushed by a pack of [[Icewolf|icewolves]], also corrupted by the dark side. After defeating the pack, they were able to enter the temple, where Malefax was interrogating Romund. They engaged the Adept, eventually defeating him and driving off the mercenaries.

==Aftermath==
The Gatekeeper then asked the Force-sensitives for their help in clearing the Temple of the dark side corruption.

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The rescue forms the basis for the ''[[Mountaintop Rescue]]'' adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beginner Game]]''. The adventure consists of seven pre-made encounters for a [[roleplaying game]].
